array_map( 'sanitize_text_field', (array) json_decode( wp_unslash( $_POST['ids'] ), true ) ) : array(); $act = isset( $_POST['act'] ) ? sanitize_key( $_POST['act'] ) : 'delete'; $hotels = self::get_hotels(); if ( 'delete' === $act ) { $hotels = array_values( array_filter( $hotels, function ( $h ) use ( $ids ) { return ! in_array( $h['id'], $ids, true ); } ) ); } else { foreach ( $hotels as $i => $h ) { if ( in_array( $h['id'], $ids, true ) ) { $hotels[ $i ]['active'] = ( 'show' === $act ); } } } self::save_hotels( $hotels ); wp_send_json_success( array( 'hotels' => self::get_hotels() ) ); } public static function ajax_restore() { self::check_ajax(); $backup = get_option( self::OPT_BACKUP ); if ( ! is_array( $backup ) || ! isset( $backup['data'] ) ) { wp_send_json_error( array( 'message' => 'Aucune sauvegarde disponible.' ) ); } self::save_hotels( (array) $backup['data'] ); delete_option( self::OPT_BACKUP ); wp_send_json_success( array( 'hotels' => self::get_hotels() ) ); } public static function ajax_settings() { self::check_ajax(); $in = isset( $_POST['settings'] ) ? '' ), array( 'a' => array( 'href' => true, 'target' => true, 'rel' => true ) ) ), 'height' => max( 320, min( 1200, absint( $in['height'] ?? 620 ) ) ), 'cluster' => empty( $in['cluster'] ) ? 0 : 1, ); $current = self::get_settings(); $out['columns'] = $current['columns']; $out['header_row'] = $current['header_row']; foreach ( array( 'legend_member', 'legend_premium' ) as $k ) { foreach ( array( 'fr', 'de', 'en' ) as $l ) { $out[ $k ][ $l ] = sanitize_text_field( $in[ $k ][ $l ] ?? $def[ $k ][ $l ] ); } } update_option( self::OPT_SETTINGS, $out, false ); wp_send_json_success( array( 'settings' => self::get_settings() ) ); } public static function ajax_geocode() { self::check_ajax(); $id = isset( $_POST['id'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['id'] ) ) : ''; $preview = ! empty( $_POST['preview'] ); if ( $preview ) { $h = self::sanitize_hotel( array( 'name' => wp_unslash( $_POST['name'] ??
